criteria.requirement: Add Factory.from_method(method_name) as an explicit opt-in default factory. Resolve the current instance class MRO at initialization and call the winning bound instance method, allowing subclasses to override it. Validate a nonempty identifier name; reject staticmethod/classmethod/property or unbound/nonmethod values without executing them. Propagate missing methods and method exceptions. Preserve ordinary Factory callable binding, takes_self behavior, explicit supplied field values and default decorators. Do not make arbitrary generated factory closures pickleable.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
